**Sub-agents can be seen, and the pane survives**

investigation · 2026-08-22

discharges: [MUS-M-0010](../milestones.md#mus-m-0010)

## Context

Whether Mustur can learn that a sub-agent exists at all, tell its output from the parent's, and know when it finishes. The three properties and the decision rule were committed before any evidence was looked at, so that 'cannot be done' stayed a permitted verdict. Two routes cleared the rule; the one adopted is the CLI's lifecycle hooks, which leave the session a tmux pane. The route that would have been easiest — an undocumented directory holding each sub-agent's transcript — was refused by the rule, which is what the rule was for.

## Status

accepted

## Decision rule

fixed before looking: enumerable, separable and terminal, on an interface the CLI documents

## Result

route accepted (lifecycle hooks); the tmux-window route registered first failed on the mechanism

## How to reproduce

Run the harness in [docs/investigations/0002-harness/](../../docs/investigations/0002-harness/): score.py and count.py re-derive the pairing and coverage numbers from the committed captures with no CLI and no network; order.sh, stream.sh and bidi.sh re-run the captures against Claude Code.
